mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_course ( review_check, place1, place2, place3, place4, place5, t_user_email, title ) VALUES ( #{reviewCheck}, PLACE(#{placeDTO1.category}, #{placeDTO1.locationName}, #{placeDTO1.address}, #{placeDTO1.business}), PLACE(#{placeDTO2.category}, #{placeDTO2.locationName}, #{placeDTO2.address}, #{placeDTO2.business}), PLACE(#{placeDTO3.category}, #{placeDTO3.locationName}, #{placeDTO3.address}, #{placeDTO3.business}), PLACE(#{placeDTO4.category}, #{placeDTO4.locationName}, #{placeDTO4.address}, #{placeDTO4.business}), PLACE(#{placeDTO5.category}, #{placeDTO5.locationName}, #{placeDTO5.address}, #{placeDTO5.business}), #{userEmail}, #{title} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS courseId, t.review_check AS reviewCheck, t.t_user_email AS userEmail, t.title AS title, t.place1.location_name AS place1LocationName, t.place1.address AS place1Address, t.place1.category AS place1Category, t.place1.business AS place1Business, t.place2.location_name AS place2LocationName, t.place2.address AS place2Address, t.place2.category AS place2Category, t.place2.business AS place2Business, t.place3.location_name AS place3LocationName, t.place3.address AS place3Address, t.place3.category AS place3Category, t.place3.business AS place3Business, t.place4.location_name AS place4LocationName, t.place4.address AS place4Address, t.place4.category AS place4Category, t.place4.business AS place4Business, t.place5.location_name AS place5LocationName, t.place5.address AS place5Address, t.place5.category AS place5Category, t.place5.business AS place5Business FROM t_course t WHERE t.t_user_email = #{email}

SELECT t.id AS courseId, t.review_check AS reviewCheck, t.t_user_email AS userEmail, t.title AS title, t.place1.location_name AS place1LocationName, t.place1.address AS place1Address, t.place1.category AS place1Category, t.place1.business AS place1Business, t.place2.location_name AS place2LocationName, t.place2.address AS place2Address, t.place2.category AS place2Category, t.place2.business AS place2Business, t.place3.location_name AS place3LocationName, t.place3.address AS place3Address, t.place3.category AS place3Category, t.place3.business AS place3Business, t.place4.location_name AS place4LocationName, t.place4.address AS place4Address, t.place4.category AS place4Category, t.place4.business AS place4Business, t.place5.location_name AS place5LocationName, t.place5.address AS place5Address, t.place5.category AS place5Category, t.place5.business AS place5Business FROM t_course t WHERE t.id IN ( SELECT t_review.t_course_id FROM t_share JOIN t_review ON t_share.t_review_id = t_review.id WHERE t_share.T_USER_EMAIL = #{email} )
